title: Moody’s ups India’s growth forecast to 7 per cent from 6.5 per cent earlier

ai.summary: Moody's upgraded India's economic growth forecast to 7% for 2026-27, citing resilient economic momentum and energy supply resilience amid rising prices.

facts.claim: Moody's Ratings raised its growth forecast for the Indian economy to 7 per cent from 6.5 per cent earlier
facts.quote: Moody’s Ratings on Wednesday raised its growth forecast for the Indian economy to 7 per cent from 6.5 per cent earlier

facts.claim: India had adjusted to higher energy prices better than previously anticipated
facts.quote: India had adjusted to higher energy prices better than previously anticipated

facts.claim: State-backed oil marketing companies and tax cuts have helped cushion households and businesses from the energy price shock
facts.quote: State-backed oil marketing companies and tax cuts have helped cushion households and businesses from the energy price shock

facts.claim: The revised outlook comes after India’s economy expanded 7.8 per cent year-on-year in the April-June quarter
facts.quote: The revised outlook comes after India’s economy expanded 7.8 per cent year-on-year in the April-June quarter

facts.claim: High frequency indicators, including robust capital goods production and imports, accelerating industrial credit growth and rising capacity utilisation, suggest that India may be at the cusp of a new private capex cycle
